AI Overview
Play Time Shooter 3: SWAT directly in your web browser. 
Overview
Genre: 3D first-person tactical shooter inspired by Superhot.
Core Mechanic: Time moves only when your character moves. Standing still slows time down to a crawl so you can dodge bullets and plan your next move.
Premise: Play as a SWAT operative rescuing hostages from armed, armored terrorists who have stolen gear like riot shields and helmets. 
Controls
WASD or Arrow Keys: Move around.
Left-Click: Shoot weapon or pick up items.
Right-Click / R: Throw your current weapon or item.
F: Handle or interact with shields. 
Gameplay Features
Weapons: Use pistols, automatic rifles, shotguns, rocket launchers, and explosive barrels.
Environment: Breach doors using battering rams and throw empty guns or shields at enemies.
Enemies: Fight armored orange targets equipped with body armor, helmets, and riot shields.
